title: Idea for directed-energy UFO shootdowns came from a Roswell survivor
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Idea for directed-energy UFO shootdowns came from a Roswell survivor, about 1947-1962 at Roswell, New Mexico, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Harold told Pippa on his deathbed and offair that the CIA and Atomic Energy Commission got the very idea of shooting down UFOs with directed energy from an extraterrestrial being that survived the Roswell crash in 1947.
